test_title: PYST 34: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: An electric pump can fill a tank in 8 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 9(1/3)​ hours to fill the tank. How much time will this leak take to empty the full tank if water does not get in or out of the tank through any other point during this period?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by pump alone = 8 hours

Time taken by pump with leak = 9(1/3) = 28/3 hours

**Formula used:**

Work rate = 1 ÷ time

Leak rate = Pump rate − Combined rate

**Calculation:**

Let total work = LCM of 8 and 28 = 56 units

Pump rate = 56 ÷ 8 = 7 units/hour

Combined rate = 56 ÷ (28/3) = 56 × 3/28 = 6 units/hour

Leak rate = 7 − 6 = 1 unit/hour

Time for leak to empty full tank = 56 ÷ 1 = 56 hours

**∴ The leak will empty the full tank in 56 hours.**
